chapter: A Chat in the Snowy Mountains
act_title: A Chat in the Snowy Mountains

quests.title: A Chat in the Snowy Mountains

dialogue.t: It's a rare occasion indeed when Miss Sandrone finds the time to visit Mondstadt.
You provided such invaluable help when I was researching the numerological array. I wanted to thank you in person.
You're too kind. But such things lie well outside my area of expertise. The credit for completing it should really be all yours.
It was a team effort. Hmm... Come to think of it, where's Durin? Seeing as you're practically his guardian, I thought he would be unable to stray too far from your side.
You're not entirely wrong.
But recently, he's been making headway with his social skills, so I've been trying to encourage him to be a bit more independent.
Aren't you worried about him?
A little. In the past, if he was on his own and interacting with someone whose personality was... let's say "strong," he tended to...
Pick up bizarre habits? Mimic unusual verbal tics?
Precisely. I take it you've experienced something similar, Miss Sandrone?
Hmph, do you even need to ask? I'm practically an expert...
Typically, after a meeting with Grand Master Varka, I'll take Durin to visit Sucrose and help with her research. It allows him to find his focus.
But if he's spent too long with Acting Grand Master Jean, we'll pay a visit to Klee so he can rediscover how to relax.
Sounds like a lot of work...
Just looking after my family.
How would you handle such situations?
Me? I don't have the energy for that sort of mess...
But it seems to me that if someone's good by nature, no matter how much they're influenced, they'll always return to their true self.
Hmm... An excellent observation. Perhaps I can adopt this way of thinking.
Thank you for treating me, Miss Sandrone.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Alright. Until we meet again.

quests.description: Go to Dragonspine, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Albedo…
